applicabilityBasis.summary: PHT is marketed for payments and remittances and APACX LTD. is expressly named as Token Issuer. The documented issuer protocol returns collateral when CDP debt is repaid; fiat exit is separately described through MoneyBees OTC shops. An APACX obligation to redeem every PHT for a fixed PHP amount was not established. Payment marketing and third-party fiat access warrant unclear applicability rather than a categorical non-payment-token exclusion.

genius.notes: New issuerEntity is exactly APACX LTD., independently confirmed in the primary PHT legal-terms excerpt. Exact issuer domicile is omitted; the base-file Singapore jurisdiction was not independently proven. APACX says beta PHT is minted against apcxUSDT; its transparency page discloses a Tron reserve wallet without an independent monthly attestation. CDP repayment releases borrower collateral, while MoneyBees provides a separate OTC fiat exit. No fixed-PHP issuer redemption obligation was established. Full linked DocSend terms were bot-blocked in static fetch; browser fallback displayed an image-based 16-page viewer but did not expose the document text. No unread eligibility or redemption clause is assumed. Public payment/remittance and overseas-worker marketing warrants retaining unclear applicability and additional terms research. The pre-effective DASP posture is not a claim that other U.S. laws permit all offers.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no qualifying public GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, official application, issuer-announced intent or foreign registration was located for pht-pht in the independently opened token materials, NYDFS tables and named-token searches listed. This is a bounded public-evidence finding and does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. Proposed implementing rules and ordinary licensing context do not establish token-specific GENIUS authorization. APACX LTD. issuer identity is confirmed, but fixed-fiat obligations in the full terms remain unresolved.
